title: Stratified Shadow Admission Orchestrator for Safe Canary Launches
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement a policy-driven orchestrator that performs stratified shadow probing and staged admission for model variants. The goal is to allow a new model variant to receive production request copies (shadow traffic) in progressively expanding, stratified cohorts, validate behavioral and perf metrics against production baselines, and automatically transition to weighted canary traffic or auto-rollback when guardrails trigger. This ticket covers: DSL for guardrail contracts, stratified cohort selection (by user segment, region, request size), probationary shadow windows, metric aggregation hooks, and the admission state machine that advances or aborts a rollout without manual intervention.
acceptance_criteria: A readable policy DSL exists to express: step schedule, cohort selectors, metric contracts (error-rate, tail-latency, semantic-drift), and rollback actions.
The orchestrator can be configured to run a 'probationary shadow' where 0% live traffic is sent but request/response copies are recorded and evaluated for N minutes.
Stratified cohort sampling supports at least: user_id hash ranges, region, device type, and custom header tags.
Automatic promotion to live canary traffic occurs only when all metric contracts pass for the preceding probationary window.
Automatic rollback triggers when any safety fence breaches during ramp (configurable thresholds and hysteresis).
Integration tests validate the admission state machine for: promote, hold, decelerate, and rollback transitions.
End-to-end smoke test and a dashboard tile in Console showing current policy state, cohort coverage, and live metrics for canaries created with this orchestrator.
technical_notes: Policy DSL: YAML-first syntax with enforcement clauses. Example fields: steps: [{percent: 5, duration: 30m, cohort: 'rand:0-1'}, ...], guards: [{metric: 'p95_latency_ms', op: '<', threshold: 1200, duration: 5m}], actions: {on_fail: 'rollback', on_warn: 'hold'}.

Probationary shadow: keep outputs ephemeral by default. Flag to persist outputs for evaluation only when drift-checkers run. Use trace-id tagging so shadow requests are excluded from billing and scoring pipelines unless explicitly enabled.

Stratification: use modular hash-based selectors to ensure reproducible cohorts across rollouts. Cohort selectors implement two-stage matching: (1) inclusion filter (headers, region, user segment), (2) hash-range partition.

Metrics & contracts: support both numeric thresholds (error rate, latency percentiles) and model-output checks (semantic similarity drift, hallucination signals). Drift checks delegate to evaluation functions in evaluations service and accept a score and delta threshold.
State machine: states = [probation, staged-ramp, steady, hold, rollback]. Transitions evaluate guard outputs over sliding windows with configurable hysteresis and cooldown timers to avoid flapping.
Rollback autopilot: integrates with routing layer to instant switch weight to baseline model and place variant in quarantine with a postmortem snapshot (logs, sampled inputs, model outputs).

Observability: emit policy events to telemetry topic (policy.events) with structured fields: policy_id, step_id, cohort, metric_summaries, decision. Console will subscribe to present human-readable timeline.
Performance: ensure shadow copying path is non-blocking and sampling rates are throttled to keep tail latency impact < 2%. Use async replication to evaluation streams.
Security: shadow data marked and encrypted in transit; if persist_pii flag enabled, require KMS hook and audit entry.
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: RFC drafted and reviewed with Platform and Eval teams. Decided on YAML-first DSL and to reuse existing evaluation functions for drift checks.
2025-02-17: Spike completed to implement non-blocking shadow copy in the runtime. Prototype shows <1.5% median latency overhead in 95th percentile test cluster.
2025-02-19: Schema for policy events finalized. Console team confirmed they can display timeline based on policy.events stream.
2025-02-22: Built initial admission state machine with unit tests for promote/rollback transitions. Edge case: overlapping cohort windows needs guard to prevent double-counting — added dedupe pass.
2025-02-25: Integration PR opened (see linked_prs). Requesting early review from Reliability and Privacy for the quarantine and PII handling flow.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Shadow copies accidentally counted in production metrics -> Mitigation: Strict trace-id tagging and a runtime guard that rejects metric ingestion with 'shadow=true' unless whitelisted by eval pipeline.
Risk: Cohort leakage causing uneven traffic exposure -> Mitigation: Deterministic hash selectors and verification job that simulates cohort partitions before rollout.
Risk: Rollout flapping when metrics are noisy -> Mitigation: Hysteresis windows and minimum-stable-duration before a re-promote; exponential backoff on retries.
Risk: PII retention in persisted shadow captures -> Mitigation: Default ephemeral; persist only with KMS and explicit approval; audit log every persist action.
